leadText: Yui (Japanese: ユイ) is one of the Ghost Masters located in the Sealed Fort, located on GR Island in Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! Yui can be found in the ninth and final statue in the main room. Players who defeat Yui will obtain a Present Pack, which can consist of any card that can be found in a booster pack in the game.
plainText:
Yui (Japanese: ユイ) is one of the Ghost Masters located in the Sealed Fort, located on GR Island in Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR! Yui can be found in the ninth and final statue in the main room. Players who defeat Yui will obtain a Present Pack, which can consist of any card that can be found in a booster pack in the game.

==Torrential Flood Deck==
Torrential Flood Deck (Japanese: おおあめこうずいデッキ) is the deck played by Yui. The deck consists entirely of Pokémon and features the Legendary Card.
